quotes.text: h3 Habitualmente, ¿cuántas horas y días trabaja a la semana? h3a Actividad principal Horas diarias Días Total horas

assessments.reasoning: Section H of the survey records hours dedicated to paid employment (e.g., in question h3a). However, the questionnaire does not collect time allocation data for unpaid domestic or care work, leisure, or self-care. Per the indicator instructions, if the instrument only records hours of paid work with no time recorded for any other daily activity, all four statements are false.
